build_notes.sha256_provenance: hashes computed over the DOWNSCALED max-1280px mirror files, not the originals; mirror is flat celebs/ + personal/ (no yyyy/mm hierarchy)
build_notes.box_convention: FaceBox normalized CENTRE-point (x,y=centre, w,h fraction) per manifest.py docstring; detector pixel bboxes (top-left origin) from inventory converted against ORIGINAL inventory dims (scale-invariant on the aspect-preserving mirror); intersected with image bounds before normalization (see clamp_log; no faces dropped)
build_notes.box_source_mapping: FaceBox.source is a free-form str in the schema (docstring says iptc|mwg but nothing validates or consumes it); TRUE provenance kept: 'detector' for DB-derived boxes, 'operator' for the 6 manual boxes. OPEN DECISION: remap to mwg if a downstream convention requires it.
build_notes.binding_rule: operator positional bindings applied at bbox x-order index (verified against note x-coords for 251/388/418; 201/220/480 position labels consistent)
build_notes.slice_tag_mapping: masked/sunglasses/occlusion_other/profile/low_res direct; blur_any->blur; occlusion_any|occlusion_partial_minor|occluded_missed_face without masked/sunglasses -> occlusion_other; informational flags sidecar-only; no similar_people flags in v6.1
build_notes.domain_priority: occlusion-family > crowds > mirrors > black_and_white > art; omitted when no family matches (no guessing)
build_notes.provenance_field: source=celeb stamped where celeb_identity_from_filename(basename) yields a name that is in present_identities (headline-identification frame keys on provenance.source==celeb); license=fixture (pre-existing eval fixture pool — upstream license unverified, publishable unset so is_publishable fails closed). Parsed-but-unconfirmed celeb filenames listed under celeb_provenance_skipped. Personal/social images stay unstamped (source=operator|localwp license=consented at curation)
build_notes.difficulty_field: omitted (not derivable from v6.1 without guessing)
build_notes.must_right_rule: must_right = present_identities (named only), easy_wrong = [] (no corrections provided easy-wrong entries)
